d:
Bhale hi nirdaliy vidhan parshad vanshidhar brajvasi aur rahul raj ne bihar vidhan parishad ki sadasyata grahan kar li ho lekin rajnitik taur par khatra tala nahin hai, kyonki jan suraj parti unki sadasyata radd karane ke lie adalat ka darvaja khatakhtane ki taiyari men hai. prashant kishor ne kaha ki bilkul vah kort jaenge.
